knowledge: Midget Sani is Bitcoin Obama's midget: a man with dwarfism whom Obama calls “the midget” or “my midget”, and who appears in many of his promo videos from 2024 on.
He has no personal X account of his own, though the @obama__nastty account created in September 2025 began as a “magical midget” persona before becoming Bitcoin Obama's main account in April 2026.
The name Sani comes from episode 6 of The Crypto Craic Podcast, “Interviewing Bitcoin Obama's Midget”, whose notes say he “can only speak his local Hausa language”.
In episode 1 Obama says the midget “was born in my state” and is “almost 43 years”.
Obama often raises money on his behalf (“feed the midget”).
It is not known whether or how Sani is paid.

Midget Sani is Bitcoin Obama's midget: a Nigerian man with dwarfism who has starred in the promo videos of Bitcoin Obama, the Nigerian crypto shiller, since 2024. He was interviewed on episode 6 of The Crypto Craic Podcast, “Interviewing Bitcoin Obama's Midget”.
